residuals.description: One aggregate PR Fast Regression decision now binds every selected shared cluster to one exact candidate SHA.
Fallback governance is explicit: fourteen manual-only workflows, zero duplicate PR fallbacks and two known inert Kassa references.

full_regression.candidate_contract: All registered authorities are workflow_dispatch'ed from one candidate branch ref and accepted only when their run head_sha equals the exact candidate SHA.

residuals.description: Prove the new single Full Regression entry point forces all fourteen P0 scenarios plus full frontend regression on one exact candidate SHA.
Define the permanent candidate trigger policy for Full Regression after F7-FULL-01 has proven the orchestration entry point.
No canonical schedule bundles expensive failure/recovery and legacy authorities into a Deep/Nightly run.
Deep-run evidence has no single aggregate result identifying the exact candidate and all executed authorities.
No single Release Acceptance orchestration binds package/build, PostgreSQL migration/startup, zero-residual and acceptance results to one candidate SHA.
PO acceptance state remains a Phase 8/9 dependency and is intentionally not invented inside F7.
Backup -> restore -> startup -> data-integrity proof remains a downstream release-readiness dependency.

cross_cutting.delta_planner_policy: For pull_request synchronize events compare complete candidate scope base.sha -> head.sha; fail open on uncertainty; manual/non-PR execution runs requested authorities.
cross_cutting.candidate_identity_policy: Every aggregate gate must emit and verify one exact candidate SHA and must reject child runs on any other SHA.
cross_cutting.evidence_policy: Aggregate gates retain machine-readable evidence containing candidate identity and all accepted workflow run IDs.

F7-01.result: gate taxonomy, shared runner map and fallback inventory established

F7-02.result: PR Fast Regression aggregate gate and fallback governance closed

F7-03.next_after_green: Close F7-FULL-01 with proof and then resolve F7-FULL-02 trigger policy.
